_comment: Windows + tastytrade. Copy to config.json. broker is the only place the broker is named, and tasty is this PC's; run_session.ps1 passes none. tasty_orders=sandbox (the default) sends to api.cert.tastyworks.com. tasty_orders=production is real money and requires tasty_data=production. run_session.ps1 defaults to dry. -Mode live auto-approves; nothing waits on a human.
_rules: Shared by both plans: 15m closes 12:00–1:00 PM ET, first qualifying bar, 1 spread. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. Flat 2 hours after the entry bar. No stop. Tastytrade does not chase a missed fill.
_plan: plan is the only trading rule that is a config key: B (the default, and what a missing key means) or A1. B: long nearest 75 delta, GTC close at debit x 1.30. A1: skip the day if any 15m close from 10:15 through 11:00 ET was already beyond the prior day's high or low, long nearest 80 delta, and exit at +8 SPX points in the trade direction or the 2-hour flat, whichever comes first - no premium target. Nothing else differs, and there is no PLAN environment variable.
_wrap: Read-only log summary: python -m spx_noon wrap (run_wrap.ps1). It does not send orders. After the markdown report it upserts one High Noon row on the shared Google Sheet; see _sheets.
_sheets: The 16:20 wrap's one daily row for Boi 'High Noon' on the sheet Candle and Fly already share. Columns, in order: Date, Boi, Traded, P&L after fees, Worst (always empty), What happened. The key is (Date, Boi), so a second wrap on the same date replaces the row. sheets_spreadsheet_id is the document id above and is not a secret. sheets_credentials is a path to the Google service-account key file; blank means C:/spx-noon-breakout/state/sheets-service-account.json. The key is never a key in this file: set SPX_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS_JSON (the whole json, kept in memory only), or SPX_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a path. Order: the json, then sheets_credentials, then those two variables, then the default path. This PC is Windows, so the tab is Tod Comp; Mac and Linux write Derek Comp. Install the client with pip install -e '.[sheets]'. A missing key or any sheet error leaves the markdown report in place, adds one status line, and still exits 0.
